data.revised_prompt: Square 1:1 centered icon asset for a school teacher app student avatar library. Single fictional Chinese girl, age 8-14, healthy, natural, friendly. High-quality 3D chibi education-app style, same refined modeling and soft materials as a premium AI assistant avatar, but clearly a student. Head-only focus with only a tiny bit of neck and white school collar visible at the bottom; not a bust portrait. Face and hair together occupy about 75%-85% of the frame. Front-facing or slight three-quarter view. Full hair silhouette visible, no hair or chin crop, no top crop. Cute but not babyish proportions. Bright brown eyes, studio soft light, slightly curious bright expression. Hairstyle: two bun pigtails, curved short bangs, two light pink thin hair ties. No accessories. Background must fully fill the entire square edge to edge with a low-saturation coral pink, no border, no transparency, no ring, no circle, no scene, no text. Clean silhouette, bold readable shapes, minimal detail, high contrast, readable at small sizes. Only a little white school lapel/collar at the bottom, no emblem, no logo.
